hpi: The patient is a 30-year-old female with a history of headaches and visual disturbances. She presents with worsening headaches and transient visual obscurations. The diagnosis of idiopathic intracranial hypertension is made based on clinical findings and imaging studies. Treatment options include weight loss and medications to reduce intracranial pressure. A referral to ophthalmology is also warranted for further evaluation of her visual symptoms.
